text:
maya: Kicking off blue/green traffic shift for router-service v2 -> v3 at 02:00 UTC change window. Plan: 5% (10m) -> 25% (10m) -> 50% (5m) -> 100% (5m). Pin v3.2.1 config on router. Release notes: https://docs.internal/redwood/releases/v3.2.1 :rocket:
deploy-bot: Preflight checks started: infra health, certs, canary test, metrics hooks. ETA ~3m. Will post results here.
deploy-bot: Preflight OK. Canary test user flows passed (login, generate, embed). No schema drift detected.
owen: Quick question — session affinity during drain? Are we using cookie pin or IP?
maya: Cookie pin for session affinity; we'll set drain timeout to 60s and maintain old route for sticky sessions for 5m after cutover.
jamie: Rollback criteria proposal: p95 latency increase > 120ms above baseline for 10m OR 5xx rate > 1% sustained for 5m should trigger immediate pause, then rollback to v2. Also manual rollback allowed. Thoughts?
sre-ops: +1 to thresholds. Add healthcheck miss count > 3/min for API router pods as a fast-fail signal.
leo: I'll run smoke probe during each step: `curl -sS https://api-eu-west.redwood.test/health | jq .` and a short harness: `scripts/traffic_probe --rate 5 --duration 60`. Will post output.
kate: Release notes updated with post-deploy validation and rollback playbook link: https://runbook.internal/redwood/blue-green-shift. Also added client-impact notes for marketplace customers.
maya: Ops timeline: 01:50 UTC — final config push and version pin across routers; 01:55 UTC — preflight confirmation; 02:00 UTC — start 5% shift. If any stage fails we'll hold and escalate to oncall.
owen: Confirmed I've got alert watches on p95, 5xx, and circuit-breaker tripped metrics. Pager duty: eng-oncall +1.
jamie: Reminder: snapshot of current routing config committed to repo at `git rev: a1f2c3d` (added to release notes).
deploy-bot: Starting traffic shift: stage=canary pct=5 target=v3.2.1
leo: Probe results for 5% stage: p95=118ms (baseline 95ms), 5xx=0.02%. No issues seen. Posting trimmed logs: `ok`
maya: Proceeding to 25% in 5m if no regressions. Please keep alerts open.
owen: Watching dashboards :eyes:  — will call immediate rollback if alerts meet thresholds.
jamie: If we need to rollback, steps are: 1) set router pin back to v2, 2) scale back v3 replicas to 0, 3) open incident channel and notify support. Rollback sprint ~4-7m.
sre-ops: Remember to clear KV cache or invalidate prefixes if we flip back — otherwise clients might hit stale KV state. Runbook has commands.
maya: Thanks all — post-deploy checklist assigned to @leo for validation and @kate to publish customer comms if cutover completes. :thumbsup:
